children: have signed a memorandum of understanding to collaborate on a sovereign artificial intelligence infrastructure offering for Canadian organizations, the companies said.
The planned offering will combine Bell’s
Canadian data centers, networks, and operational capabilities with Cisco’s
AI infrastructure, security, observability, and management technologies.

The companies said they aim to develop architectures capable of supporting AI training and inference workloads, targeting government agencies, regulated industries, and other organizations seeking greater control over where sensitive systems and data are located and managed.
As part of the collaboration, Bell
will evaluate Cisco AI PODs and Sovereign Critical Infrastructure technologies alongside Bell’s Canadian data center capacity, including power, cooling, connectivity, and operational services.
The companies will also explore flexible consumption models that would allow customers to access or reserve AI infrastructure, building on Bell
The initiative comes as organizations increasingly seek infrastructure arrangements that provide greater control over the location and management of sensitive AI systems and data.
